title: chelidonium hylomeconoides
intro: Chelidonium hylomeconoides, commonly known as Celandine, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Papaveraceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to treat skin conditions, such as warts and ulcers, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Celandine include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve digestion, and reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Celandine include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
